reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates low friction and wear for the 2D HEA phase itself at room temperature under high contact pressure, but it provides no data on coating a CoCrFeNi matrix, no high-temperature testing, and no evidence of self-replenishing tribofilm behavior across a broad temperature range. Thus, the key premises about application to CoCrFeNi and sustained performance up to 800 °C are unsupported.
premises: A 2D HEA phase (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 can be applied as a thin, uniform coating on a CoCrFeNi matrix.
The coating provides self-lubrication via shear-induced energy dissipation and tribocatalytic activity.
The coating forms a self-replenishing tribofilm that maintains low friction and wear from RT to 800 °C.
The coating will reduce friction and wear relative to uncoated CoCrFeNi across the full temperature range.
